affected_boundaries: local commit gate to registered foreign worktrees

observed_behavior: A commit in one registered repository could fail because another registered repository was missing or had dirty or invalid live configuration.
expected_behavior: A local commit gate depends only on the invoking repository and durable validated foreign identity inputs; live global registration health is checked only when explicitly requested.
causal_mechanism: Reference QA called the strict live blessed-worktree validator for every foreign registration, so an unrelated worktree's availability and cleanliness became inputs to the local pre-commit result.

anti_pattern.structural_description: A local gate synchronously validates mutable live state owned by independent projects.
anti_pattern.why_it_fails: The gate couples independent sessions and repositories: unrelated deletion, dirt, checkout movement, or configuration work can deny a valid local operation.

correct_pattern.required_invariant: Local gates consume durable last-known-good foreign metadata and never inspect live foreign worktrees; an explicit global command owns live health and freshness checks.
correct_pattern.implementation_description: Store validated foreign identity snapshots in the versioned user registry, use them for local reference QA, and compare them with live blessed-worktree identities only in ponytail validate --all.

applicability_conditions: A local operation needs metadata from independently mutable projects or sessions.
Foreign live state can be represented by a small validated snapshot with an explicit refresh lifecycle.
known_non_matches: An explicitly requested global health check whose purpose is to validate every live registration.
confirmation_evidence: The pre-fix regression test failed because dirty foreign configuration made a valid commit return status 1.
After the fix, the same commit succeeds while ponytail validate --all reports the dirty foreign registration.
regression_proofs: tests/project-validation.test.js: pre-commit ignores dirty foreign configuration while global validation reports it
tests/project-validation.test.js: local QA keeps the snapshot until explicit refresh and global validation reports staleness
